_note: One entry per team. 'changes' items: {t, c: [clause ids], b: 'doc'|'interp'}. 'channels' lists playbook IDs. The fix-now page can be filtered by department with fix-now.html?dept=<id>.

departments.name: Account management
departments.summary: You are the link between the client's doctor and our work. The doctor is responsible for what is published, so your job is to get approvals in writing and keep a record.

start.t: Get written approval from the doctor for each change and each new deliverable
Collect doctor name, qualifications, registration status and SMR/NMR number, and have the client confirm them in writing
Collect proof for every award, accreditation and device claim
Keep consent records for any patient material and ask the client to confirm what exists
Brief clients on the changes and what will be removed

stop.t: Agreeing to client requests for testimonials, before-and-after content, offers or “best” claims
Starting influencer, paid-editorial or review campaigns

departments.name: Performance marketing
departments.summary: Ad copy, keywords, assets, audiences and landing-page match all change. Your accounts carry the most live content.

start.t: Write factual ad copy: service, place, contact, fees
Check every destination URL before an ad goes live
Audit audiences and data sources and keep a consent record
Review the fee model with Leadership

stop.t: Superlatives, guarantees, results, patient counts in ads
Dynamic keyword insertion
Review, rating, offer, promotion and result-image assets
Before-and-after, testimonial and influencer creative
Lead-gen offers, giveaways and contests
AI-generated people and automatic generative creative

departments.name: SEO
departments.summary: Titles, meta, local pages, GBP and anything about reviews. The NMC text is clear on reviews and silent on most SEO tactics, so use caution and escalate open questions.

start.t: Write factual titles and meta descriptions
Keep GBP to factual details
Audit and drop review markup
Audit directory and platform listings for paid ranking

stop.t: Asking for, incentivising or gating reviews
Buying or faking reviews, followers or engagement
Superlatives in titles, headings and local pages
GBP offer posts
Manipulating rankings or visibility in a misleading way

departments.name: Social media
departments.summary: Your content calendar changes the most: no reviews, results, offers or collaborations, and the doctor's details must be visible.

start.t: Plan calendars around education, announcements and factual facility posts
Show doctor identity in the bio and on posts featuring the doctor
Mark AI-generated content
Check any patient or staff in frame before posting

stop.t: Review and testimonial reposts
Before-and-after and transformation posts
Offers, contests, giveaways and festival discounts
Influencer and celebrity collaborations
Fake followers, likes or comments

departments.name: Content
departments.summary: You write the words. Education stays, and promotion goes. Every article and page needs an accurate, doctor-checked claim and a byline.

start.t: Keep educational content educational and non-promotional
Get the doctor to confirm every medical claim, and cite sources
Add the doctor byline with registration details
State risks and limits, and that results vary

stop.t: Superlatives, comparisons and patient counts
Guarantees, “painless”, “permanent”, “miracle”
Patient stories and case studies for promotion
Fear-based hooks
Publishing AI-written medical copy without doctor review

departments.name: Video and design
departments.summary: Shoot plans, scripts, edits and visuals change. Many problems are decided at the planning stage, so check before the shoot, not after the edit.

start.t: Plan shoots around the doctor explaining a topic, the clinic and its equipment
Blur, crop or exclude anything that identifies a patient
Put the doctor's name, qualifications and registration number on screen or in the caption
Mark AI-generated or materially AI-altered visuals

stop.t: Patient testimonials and interviews
Before-and-after layouts, split screens, “results” templates
Slogans with superlatives, stars or counters on creatives
AI patients, AI doctor avatars, AI voices
Doctor endorsing products on camera
Filming procedures for marketing until the live-surgery framework is checked

departments.name: Web development
departments.summary: Templates, modules, plugins, schema and forms. You remove modules and make structural changes, so we need a clean redirect and a clean template.

start.t: Add a doctor identity block as a reusable component
Redirect removed pages to factual pages
Add consent text and a privacy link on every form
Add an AI source mark component

stop.t: Testimonial, results, before-and-after and review modules
Counters and stat blocks about patients or success
Review and AggregateRating schema
Offer banners, countdown timers and pop-ups
Star-rating widgets and review sliders

departments.name: Leadership
departments.summary: You decide the grey areas, review contracts and fee models, and track further NMC clarifications.

start.t: Review this guide and decide the open questions on the grey-areas page
Review fee models for links to individual patients
Update contracts and scope of work (see Going forward)
Own a monthly check of NMC clarifications and State Medical Council guidance
Sign off any use of verifiable superlatives, awards or scientific cases

stop.t: Taking on work that requires prohibited content
